scope: One independently authored two-series clustered horizontal bar chart with positive, negative, zero and missing values. This working-tree observation does not qualify arbitrary chart appearances, native typography, tagged or archival output, or live Word execution.
provenance: The generator uses XlsxWriter 3.2.9 (BSD-2-Clause) to author the chart XML and an existing synthetic MIT OOXML shell and local workbook. It removes an unrelated equation. The shell SHA-256 is a39b50ecb9e5d4d0f11ef0ac1988aa976c5ab6b6ffd3c832867130bac4150ad8.
schema: Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero errors for the independent input and saved DOCX; validator DLL SHA-256 4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.
independentReader: LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 420(Build:2), Ubuntu 24.04, writer_pdf_Export, pinned Noto fonts, image sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644; Poppler 25.03.0 pdftocairo -svg and pdftotext -bbox-layout on the host.
result: The chart XML and workbook bytes survive saving. Both renderers preserve the expected data, signed-bar zero alignment, bottom-up category order, series and legend order, normalized lengths and default gap thickness. The absolute geometry checks below remain failures; normalized checks do not replace them.

retainedAbsoluteGeometryFailures.handling: BestEffort and Lenient report Chart.BarLayoutApproximation. Strict static layout rejects it; the public Strict PDF path can first reject the existing editable-object loss.

retainedFirstPrototype.observation: The first prototype placed category labels at the plot edge, leaving about 70.973 points to the zero axis versus 7.289 points in LibreOffice. The final layout places them next to zero; its remaining absolute differences are recorded above.

earlierAttempts: Focused development found an ARGB XPS color assertion and a public Strict diagnostic precedence assumption that did not match actual behavior; both assertions were corrected while retaining direct checks of the chart-specific loss and atomic Strict rejection.
limitations: The generator, probe and checker are committed; generated documents and PDFs remain scratch artifacts. Exact-commit, package and hosted runtime qualification require separate evidence.
